intro: Bring style and functionality together with the Gayle coffee table. It effortlessly balances modern aesthetics and everyday practicality, making it a must-have for your home.

features.title: Sleek glass top, built to last
features.text: Designed for elegance and safety, the tempered glass surface offers durability and scratch resistance, making it perfect for daily use and gatherings.

features.title: Small in size, big on function
features.text: Small yet spacious, the table offers plenty of room for essentials without overwhelming your living area.

features.title: Strong, stable, and reliable
features.text: Built with high-quality tempered glass, the Gayle Coffee Table stands strong through everyday use, ensuring stability and longevity.

features.title: Minimal effort, maximum style
features.text: Effortlessly stylish and easy to clean, it’s the perfect choice for modern, fuss-free living.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
